evidence_quotes: Verweerder heeft voldoende gemotiveerd afgeweken van bezwaarschriftencommissie.
rationale: The Dutch administrative court decision (RBMNE) explicitly adjudicates an appeal concerning the rejection of an application for a water permit ('Afwijzing aanvraag watervergunning'). Under the protocol, disputes over a Dutch watervergunning (Waterwet/waterboard regulatory permit) are substantively WATER under both labels and fall squarely into the regulatory_permit governance category, with no household utility connection refusal or informal settlement issue involved.
